payload.lesson: The 6 m climb and northbound obstacle avoidance developed substantial northward and westward speed. I initiated the east turn with high lateral speed and insufficient clearance from the water area. The first airframe collision occurred at 27.935 simulated seconds; the command lease expired later at 29.71 seconds. Do not attribute the initial impact to the later command loss. Plan a velocity reduction and safe route earlier, and treat edgewise flow above 5 m/s as uncalibrated. The displayed water has no flotation or hydrodynamic impact model.
